METADATA.title: Vintage Gibson Value Guide: Find Your Model And Year
METADATA.description: Find your Gibson model and open its value guide, with Les Paul, SG, ES, archtop and acoustic references, condition notes and photos from Joe's own archive.

OUTLINE: Not Sure Which Gibson You Have?
BODY:
# Vintage Gibson Value Guide

Choose your Gibson model to find its value guide. I've gathered the solidbody, ES, archtop and acoustic guides here so you can go straight to the year and condition that match yours.

[IMAGE 1]

## Solidbody Guitar Guides

I've gathered the Les Paul, SG and Firebird guides here. Choose the model on your guitar, then use that guide's year and condition references.

If you haven't identified the SG version, start with the family overview. [Compare The SG Models](/vintage-gibson-sg-value-guide/).

### Les Paul Standard

[IMAGE 2]

Find Goldtop and Sunburst references, with links to the individual year guides.

[Explore The Les Paul Standard Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-les-paul-market-value-guide/)

### Les Paul Junior

[IMAGE 3]

Compare Junior configurations, finish references and condition notes in its own guide.

[Explore The Les Paul Junior Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-les-paul-junior-value-guide/)

### Les Paul Special

[IMAGE 4]

Explore Special references, including TV Yellow examples and the covered production years.

[Explore The Les Paul Special Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-les-paul-special-value-guide/)

### Les Paul Custom

[IMAGE 5]

Find the Custom guide for its pickup configurations, construction periods and condition notes.

[Explore The Les Paul Custom Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-les-paul-custom-value-guide/)

### SG Standard

[IMAGE 6]

Go straight to Standard references, with the covered years and condition assumptions.

[Explore The SG Standard Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-sg-standard-value-guide/)

### SG Special

[IMAGE 7]

Read the Special guide for its annual comparisons and notes on originality and repairs.

[Explore The SG Special Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-sg-special-value-guide/)

### SG Junior

[IMAGE 8]

Find Junior references by year, with the condition and source notes beside the comparisons.

[Explore The SG Junior Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-sg-junior-value-guide/)

### SG Custom

[IMAGE 9]

Explore the Custom guide for its covered periods, finish distinctions and condition notes.

[Explore The SG Custom Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-sg-custom-value-guide/)

### Firebird

[IMAGE 10]

Choose the Firebird model and construction group before reading its value references.

[Explore The Firebird Value Guide](/post/gibson-firebird-history-authentication-value/)

## ES And Archtop Guides

Choose the exact ES or archtop model before comparing years and configurations. Each guide keeps its price references with the condition and source notes.

### ES-335

[IMAGE 11]

Find annual ES-335 references, with condition notes and links to the existing year guides.

[Explore The ES-335 Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-es-335-value-guide/)

### ES-345

[IMAGE 12]

Read the ES-345 guide for model history, configuration details and value references.

[Explore The ES-345 Value Guide](/post/gibson-es-345-history-value/)

### ES-355

[IMAGE 13]

Compare the ES-355 configurations and covered years in its dedicated value guide.

[Explore The ES-355 Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-es-355-value-guide/)

### ES-330

[IMAGE 14]

Find ES-330 references with pickup, finish and condition distinctions explained together.

[Explore The ES-330 Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-es-330-value-guide/)

### ES-125

[IMAGE 15]

Use the ES-125 guide for its stated model scope, year references and condition notes.

[Explore The ES-125 Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-es-125-value-guide/)

### ES-5 And Switchmaster

[IMAGE 16]

Explore ES-5 and Switchmaster references alongside the model history and configurations.

[Explore The ES-5 And Switchmaster Value Guide](/post/gibson-es-5-switchmaster-history-value/)

### L-5 CES

[IMAGE 17]

Open the L-5 CES guide for its construction groups, condition context and value references.

[Explore The L-5 CES Value Guide](/post/gibson-l5-ces-value-guide/)

### Super 400

[IMAGE 18]

Find Super 400 references with the model distinctions and condition notes in one place.

[Explore The Super 400 Value Guide](/post/gibson-super-400-ces-history-authentication-value/)

## Acoustic Guitar Guides

Open the guide for your acoustic model, then check its covered years and repair notes. Include any known neck, bridge or body work when comparing your guitar.

For help choosing a model guide, I've also gathered the acoustic families in one overview. [Explore The Gibson Acoustic Overview](/vintage-gibson-acoustic-value-guide/).

### J-45

[IMAGE 19]

Use the J-45 guide for year references and notes on the condition of the actual guitar.

[Explore The J-45 Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-j-45-value-guide/)

### J-200

[IMAGE 20]

Explore J-200 references, with the covered years and the limits of the available comparisons.

[Explore The J-200 Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-j-200-value-guide/)

### Hummingbird

[IMAGE 21]

Find Hummingbird value references alongside its history and year-by-year model changes.

[Explore The Hummingbird Value Guide](/post/vintage-gibson-hummingbird-history-value-guide/)

### LG Series

[IMAGE 22]

Choose the LG model within the series guide, then read its year and condition references.

[Explore The LG Series Value Guide](/vintage-gibson-lg-series-value-guide/)

## Before You Compare Your Gibson

Start with the model, then match the year, configuration and condition in its guide. A familiar body shape or finish isn't enough to choose a comparison. I've kept the detailed tables on the model pages so their assumptions stay beside the figures.

Describe any changed parts, repairs or refinishing you know about. Keep removed parts and paperwork with the guitar, and include its case in your photographs. If something is uncertain, say so; I can help you work through it.


## Not Sure Which Gibson You Have?

Send me clear photos of the front, back, headstock and case, plus any history you know. I'll help you identify the model and work through an appraisal.

[Ask Joe About Your Gibson](/free-appraisal/)

## Questions About Gibson Values

### Where Can I Find A Price Range For My Gibson?

Choose your model above, then find its year and configuration in the guide. I've kept the price tables and condition notes together on those model pages so you can read the assumptions with each comparison.

### Which Guide Should I Use For An SG?

The Standard, Special, Junior and Custom each have a dedicated guide linked above. If you're unsure which SG you have, start with the SG family overview or send me photographs before choosing a comparison.

### Are Gibson Acoustic Guitars Included?

Yes. I've linked the J-45, J-200, Hummingbird and LG-series guides in the acoustic section. The Gibson acoustic overview connects those pages and explains the coverage for related models.

### What If I Don't Know My Gibson's Model Or Year?

Send me clear photographs of the whole guitar, both sides of the headstock and its case, along with any history you know. You don't need to remove parts or open the electronics before getting in touch.
